info.prompt: Orthographic aerial shot of a gothic neural network: 20 bio-mechanical modules {pulsing|crackling|humming} with synaptic pathways in {#c8d400 chartreuse|#3388ff azure} across a mathematical grid, Horror and Roguelike nodes looming as {cathedral spires|obsidian monoliths} with intricate {circuit-board tracery|bone filigree}. Faint ASCII symbols flicker like stained glass in the negative space, while a 140 BPM LFO throb distorts the perspective slightly with each pulse. Tier indicators glow like {chalice flames|holographic seals} at each node’s base, their light casting {long|jagged} shadows across the grid’s precise coordinates.
